sources.entry: GlobaLeaks - Whistleblowing software enabling anyone to easily set up and maintain a secure reporting platform. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Python/deb/Docker

summary.one_liner: GlobaLeaks is free, open-source whistleblowing software for setting up and maintaining a secure reporting platform.
summary.what_it_does: The README is brief and mostly points elsewhere: it describes GlobaLeaks as free and open-source whistleblowing software that lets anyone set up and maintain a secure reporting platform. It states the project is recognized by the Digital Public Good Alliance. Documentation is linked at docs.globaleaks.org, with community support via a forum and chat and a Security Policy for reporting vulnerabilities. Contribution guidelines and brand assets are referenced but not detailed in the README. The README does not describe specific features, setup steps, or the technical architecture. The awesome-selfhosted listing gives the stack as Python, deb packages and Docker.
use_cases: set up an anonymous whistleblower reporting channel
run a secure tip-submission platform for an organization
accept confidential reports from employees or the public
notable: Recognized by the Digital Public Good Alliance as a Digital Public Good
Released under AGPLv3 with additional terms under section 7 aimed at whistleblower awareness and administrator responsibility
caveats: README gives no installation or run instructions; see external documentation
Community-driven project without major corporate backing, relies on donations
keywords: free alternative to hosted whistleblower services
